title: Patreon NFT
tagline: Content sharing platform that allows creators to give access to their content by NFTs.
description: Patreon NFT is a content sharing platform powered by NFTs. By this project content creators can let their fans support them by purchasing NFTs. Content creators can sell NFTs and fans can access their content by purchasing NFTs. NFTs are divided into tiers and access level is different for each level. Users can achieve more access buy purchasing high tier NFTs.
how_its_made: This project uses Harmony Protocol as the blockchain. Token minting and transaction perform on Harmony Protocol. ReactJS is used to build frontend and NodeJS is used as the backend of the web app. MongoDB is used for store data. Smart contracts are developed using Solidity. One Wallet chrome extension is used as the wallet.
